== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ウーキーに勝たせてやれ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：“デジャリックの勝負”で戦闘運命数を1回余分に引く。2：自分の側が敗北したゲームで、ウーキーが生き残った時に使用する。同じ場所にいる相手のキャラクターで能力値＜5のものに配備する。キャラクターは“腕を引っこ抜かれる”（戦闘力－1、加えて武器を持てなくなる）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「あんまりウーキーを怒らせるな」「お言葉ですが、ドロイドの機嫌は損ねても構わないとおっしゃるのですか？」「ああ、ドロイドは勝負に負けたって、相手の腕を引っこ抜いたりしないからな」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Let The Wookiee Win]].

'''Lore''' — Don't upset a Wookiee too much. Sir, are you saying it is fine to upset a droid? Ah, a droid does not rip someone's arm out when it loses.

'''Game text''' — Choose one. 1: During a "dejarik contest," draw one extra battle destiny. 2: Use when a Wookiee survived a game your side lost. Deploy on an opponent's character of ability less than 5 at the same location. The character has an arm ripped out (power -1, and can no longer carry weapons).

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese labels the two modes after どちらかを選ぶ. It says a game your side lost, not a battle you just lost. Disarmed is printed as having an arm ripped out.<ref>[[:File:ANewHope-L-letthewookieewin-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Let The Wookiee Win]].</ref>
